## Library Loading

```{r}
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
```

## Data Folder

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
raw_data_dir <- here("data/_raw")

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  dir.create(data_dir)
}

if (!dir.exists(raw_data_dir)) {
  dir.create(raw_data_dir)
}
```

## Donor Metadata

#### (Roke)

```{r}
url <- "https://aging.brain-map.org/api/v2/data/query.csv?criteria=model::ApiTbiDonorDetail,rma::options[num_rows$eqall]"
  
donor_metadata <- read_csv(url)

write_csv(x = donor_metadata,
          file = str_c(raw_data_dir, "/donor_metadata.csv"))
```

## Protein Data

#### (Pilar)

```{r}
prot_data <- read_csv("https://aging.brain-map.org/api/v2/data/query.csv?criteria=model::ApiTbiDonorMetric,rma::options[num_rows$eqall]")

write_csv(x = prot_data,
          file = str_c(raw_data_dir, "/prot_data.csv"))
```

## RNA-Seq Data

#### (Teo)

```{r}
url <- "https://aging.brain-map.org/api/v2/well_known_file_download/502999992"
rnaseq.zip <- file.path(raw_data_dir, "rnaseq.zip")

options(timeout=300)
if (!file.exists(rnaseq.zip)){
  download.file(url, destfile = rnaseq.zip, mode = "wb")
}
unzip(rnaseq.zip, exdir = raw_data_dir)

fpkm_normalized <- read_csv(here("data", "_raw", "fpkm_table_normalized.csv"))
```
